description: Returns the paid x402 request for your order of Lookalike-domain alerts, monthly (POST /buy/brandwatch-monthly, $99 in one payment; schema linked); this call places and charges nothing, and an order exists only if your own client pays that request. POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client; the order id and status link come back with the receipt. Bad input is refused before any charge. Free check first: POST the same body plus your email to /buy/brandwatch-monthly/check (email required there). One month: evidence pack within 24 hours of payment, then a scan and emailed digest every 7 days for 30 days, no automatic billing.
